description: The fee for an if-so payment of one condition kind (TIME, PRICE, SPORTS, MARKET, APPROVE_PARTIES or APPROVE_REFEREE): the flat creation fee, plus the flat result fee for SPORTS and MARKET, read from the contract (the same numbers as ifso_version). With an amount, also the total the sender approves and whether the amount is inside the contract's limits. Fees are flat and never a share of the amount.

amount.description: Optional amount in USDG, e.g. "20" or "20.5".

kind.description: The condition kind, as in ifso_list_conditions.

name: ifso_quote_fees
title: IFSO fees for a payment
